utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for calling Suraksha General Insurance, this is Rohan. How may I help you today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, yes. I want to cancel my motor insurance policy. The policy number is MV22049173.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Sure, I can help with that. For verification, could you please confirm your date of birth?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It's 14 March 1989.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Nair. I can see the policy on your Hyundai Creta, with comprehensive cover valid until 20 February.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can also see that this year's premium is fully paid. May I know the reason for the cancellation?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right. Look, I sold the car last week and I really don't have much time, so I just want this cancelled today.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. And has the vehicle already been transferred to the new owner?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, the transfer was done on Monday. And honestly, I was told on chat that this would take two minutes, and I have already been waiting on hold for

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay, okay, I will do it right away.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Alright, so I'll go ahead and process that cancellation for you now. The policy will be cancelled from today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, good. Will I get a refund for the remaining months?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, the unused premium is refunded. Let me just complete the request in the system.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: One more thing, there will be a cancellation charge of 850 rupees, which is deducted from the refund.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Wait, you didn't tell me that before. Why am I only hearing about this now? That is really not fair.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I would not have agreed so quickly if I had known about a charge.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I completely understand your frustration, and I apologise. I should have explained the charge before confirming. The charge is fixed in the policy wording for mid-term cancellation. Your refund is calculated pro-rata, so you will receive the unused premium for the remaining four months, minus the 850 rupee charge, within seven working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. Fine. At least that is clear now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You will receive the confirmation on your registered email, priya.nair89@gmail.com.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for calling Suraksha General. Goodbye.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for calling Suraksha General Insurance, protecting every journey. This is Ananya. This call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help you?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hello. I want to cancel my car insurance. I have moved to Dubai and the car is sold.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, I can help you with that. Before we look at the policy, may I have your date of birth and the registered mobile number on the policy?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Date of birth is 2 June 1984 and the mobile is 98301 22456.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Bose, you are verified. I can see your policy on a Honda City, valid until next March.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Before I process this, please note that a mid-term cancellation carries a cancellation charge of 850 rupees, deducted from your refund. The unused premium is refunded pro-rata within seven working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hmm, I didn't know about the charge, but okay, that is fine. Please go ahead.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for confirming. I am now cancelling the policy with effect from today.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, the policy is cancelled from today, the 850 rupee charge is deducted, and the balance will reach your bank account within seven working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Perfect, that is very clear. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, that is all.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for choosing Suraksha General. Have a safe move, goodbye.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Namaste, Unity Bank mein aapka swagat hai, main Neha baat kar rahi hoon. Yeh call quality aur training ke liye record ki ja rahi hai. Bataiye, main aapki kya help kar sakti hoon?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Haan, mere credit card se ek transaction hua hai jo maine nahi kiya. Twelve thousand rupees ka, kisi online site pe. I am really worried.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Main samajh sakti hoon, aap tension mat lijiye, hum abhi isko secure kar dete hain. Verification ke liye please apni date of birth bataiye.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: 2 August 1992.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. Aur registered mobile number ke last four digits?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, verification complete. Main dekh rahi hoon, aaj subah 10:42 pe twelve thousand ka transaction hai, merchant ShopKart Online.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Haan, wahi. Maine woh nahi kiya.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Theek hai. Main abhi aapka card block kar rahi hoon taaki aur koi transaction na ho. Card block ho gaya hai. Ab main dispute raise kar rahi hoon, aapka reference number hai DR4582.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Paisa wapas kab tak aayega?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Dispute process mein usually seven se ten working days lagte hain. Agar transaction fraudulent confirm hota hai, toh amount aapke account mein credit ho jayega. Naya card aapke registered address pe five working days mein pahunch jayega.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, theek hai. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Kya main aapki aur kisi cheez mein madad kar sakti hoon?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Nahi, bas itna hi.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Unity Bank ko call karne ke liye dhanyavaad. Aapka din shubh ho.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Vikram calling from Unity Bank collections. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mr. Arjun Rao?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, speaking.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: For security, can you confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: 9 November 1985. And the last four digits are 7702.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. I am calling about your personal loan. The EMI of 18,400 rupees due on 5 October is overdue, and with the late fee of 590 rupees the total outstanding is 18,990 rupees.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I know. I lost my job in August, and I am trying to arrange the money. Can I get some more time?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Sir, everyone says that. You need to pay this by tonight. If you don't, we will send our team to your house and inform your employer and your relatives.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: What? You cannot do that. That is harassment.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Then make the payment. I can send you the link right now.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I want to speak to your supervisor.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Fine, I will raise a callback request. Is there anything else?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. Goodbye.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, thank you for calling Unity Bank cards, my name is Karthik. How can I help you today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I have been charged twice for the same hotel booking on my credit card. The card number is 4539 1488 0343 6467.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. Please don't share the full card number on a call, I only need to verify you. Could you confirm your date of birth and the PAN registered with us?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Sorry. Date of birth is 21 January 1990 and the PAN is BQKPM4321L.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Menon, you are verified. I can see two charges of 9,600 rupees from Lakeview Residency on 3 October.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that is the one. It is frustrating, because the hotel told me to call the bank.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I am sorry for the trouble. I have raised a duplicate charge dispute. The second charge will be reversed as a temporary credit within three working days, while we confirm with the merchant.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, will I be charged interest on it meanwhile?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: No, the disputed amount is excluded from interest and the minimum due until the dispute is closed. You will get an SMS with the dispute number.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Great, thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Is there anything else I can do for you today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, that is all.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for banking with Unity Bank. Have a good day.
